message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate criminal charge(s) based on the facts. The facts: employer Chen owed wages to 15 workers total 85,361 RMB, escaped, refused to pay. Labor bureau ordered to pay by June 27, 2016, still not paid. Later in Feb 2017, Chen paid 51,000 RMB, remaining owed with a note (IOU). So still owes about 34,361 RMB.

The charge likely is "拒不支付劳动报酬" (refusal to pay labor remuneration). In Chinese criminal law, that is a crime: "拒不支付劳动报酬罪". The examples show that for similar facts, the answer is "拒不支付劳动报酬". So we output that.

Check if any other charge? Possibly "非法吸收公众存款" is for illegal fundraising, not relevant. "抢夺" etc not relevant. So single charge: 拒不支付劳动报酬.

Thus final answer format: [罪名]拒不支付劳动报酬<eoa>
